documents.intake_text: Hi doctor, I am a 26 year old male. I am 5 feet and 9 inches tall and weigh 255 pounds. When I eat spicy food, I poop blood. Sometimes when I have constipation as well, I poop a little bit of blood. I am really scared that I have colon cancer. I do have diarrhea often. I do not have a family history of colon cancer. I got blood tests done last night. Please find my reports attached.
documents.signed_note: 26 y/o male, established patient. CC: intermittent hematochezia. HPI: bright red blood per rectum, small volume, associated with spicy food and constipation; frequent diarrhea; reports mild weight loss. Denies family history of colorectal cancer. Data: reviewed outside CBC (no anemia). Ordered fecal occult blood test. Vitals: ht 69in, wt 255lb, BMI 37.6. Assessment/Plan: (1) Hematochezia - refer for diagnostic colonoscopy, FOBT today; (2) Constipation - dietary fiber, hydration; (3) Diarrhea - monitor. Return if bleeding increases or new symptoms. Electronically signed.
documents.transcript:
Provider: Tell me about the bleeding - how much, what color, and how often?
Patient: Bright red, a little, mostly after spicy food or when I'm constipated. A few times a month.
Provider: Any weight loss, or change in your stools besides the blood?
Patient: I've lost a bit of weight and I get diarrhea pretty often.
Provider: I reviewed the CBC you brought - it's reassuring, no anemia. Given the bleeding and the weight change, I'm going to order a stool occult blood test today and refer you for a colonoscopy to be safe. We'll hold off on any new medication for now.
